character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout every scene: short ash-silver hair, dark brown eyes, with a distinctive stable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a lunar greenhouse technician who watches Earth rise above the horizon. Their fixed signature outfit is a white and graphite EVA work suit with blue mission piping and magnetic boots. Their defining personal object is a small pressed leaf sealed inside a transparent helmet charm. Preserve this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object across the full music video.
consistency_rules: Maintain this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout the theme.
Keep face, hair shape and color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions stable in every scene.
Preserve the signature costume design and its identifying accessory or personal object.
Do not change the lead's identity or introduce a second protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.
